references.scene: COMMON: an intimate volcanic shore at deepest night. A tiny exquisite black shore crab stands on slick basalt beside a perfectly still tide pool; pearl-silver edges of its small shell and claws are distinct, its anatomy natural and graceful. Fine sea foam traces a broken line on the rock. Enormous black cliffs dissolve in the distance; a narrow ocean horizon under charcoal clouds, moon a tiny ember hook. The emotional focus is quiet close observation and wet stone texture, not spectacle. The same masterwork craftsmanship as a legendary card.

Both broad wing tips entirely visible, long graceful tail safely framed. Fine organic nacre seams run along the smoky-black wing folds like worn silver silk. The ray is the clear readable focus, with two small serene eyes, natural manta anatomy and no cute human expression. Submerged basalt ribs lead into great depth. The night sky is only faintly mirrored at the surface, with a small broken ember crescent reflection. Quiet presence, intimate mystery and a precious living material.

references.scene: EPIC: three immense deep-sea jellyfish drift like slow nocturnal bells through the opening of a monumental submerged basalt arch. The nearest translucent smoky-black bell dominates, all its contour entirely inside the art. Narrow nacre-white ribs make the living geometry readable; long graphite tentacles weave in controlled sweeping curves, not chaos. Two distant bells establish immense depth and an elegant procession. No neon bioluminescent bloom: their light feels reflected and extremely restrained. A far slit of dark water surface high above carries one tiny broken ember crescent. Great scale and movement, mysterious and beautiful, very dark yet clearly structured.

references.scene: LEGENDARY: a colossal ancient black whale rises diagonally from an immense ocean abyss toward a narrow surface opening. Its entire sculptural body, broad flukes and pectoral fins are comfortably inside frame. The black skin looks living, ancient and impossibly precious: one long healed silver-nacre scar curves across its shoulder and flank, fine natural ridges catch a controlled pearl sheen, and its small dark eye holds a solemn peaceful presence. No armor, ornaments or unnatural appendages. Tiny distant fish and layered drowned cliffs establish mythic scale. Almost all surroundings are deep black with subtly separated depth; a very small hooked ember moon reflected above ties it to the world. Breathtaking sovereign encounter, considerably more material and presence than the other tiers, no dramatic explosion or blinding glow.
